brief.subject: Truckload capacity still not recovering; CA diesel above $8
brief.headline: No Truckload Capacity Rebound Yet as California Diesel Stays Above $8
brief.dek: Capacity shows no sign of recovering, California diesel stays high, a border crackdown worries shippers, and fraud cases reach court.
brief.lede: Despite months of rate inflation, truckload data shows no sign of capacity recovering. Small carriers waiting for a market turn should keep planning around current conditions.

sections.heading: Truckload Capacity Still Not Bouncing Back
bullets: Truckload capacity shows no signs of recovering, despite months of rate inflation.
The rebound many expected is not showing up in the data, so plan cash flow around today's market.
Intermodal rail volumes rose 10% in the latest U.S. rail traffic count, keeping pressure on long-haul truck freight.

sections.heading: California Diesel Holds Above $8
bullets: California diesel prices remain above $8 per gallon, and truckers are calling for relief.
An energy expert warns elevated costs could extend well into next year.
Carriers running California lanes should price fuel surcharges with high costs in mind.

sections.heading: Border Crackdown Raises Disruption Fears
bullets: A U.S. trucking crackdown at the Mexico border is raising concerns about cross-border freight disruptions.
Carriers and dispatchers on Mexico lanes should watch for schedule and handoff impacts.

sections.heading: Courts Hit Verdicts, Scams and Smugglers
bullets: A Texas judge upheld the nuclear verdict against C.H. Robinson, showing large jury awards remain a live risk.
32 months in jail: Louisiana staged-accident mastermind Danny Keating has finally been sentenced.
25 people were charged after a drug ring used unsuspecting trucking companies to haul cocaine from California to Florida.
More than 45 kilograms of cocaine were seized, a reminder to vet unfamiliar shippers and loads closely.
